name: log_interaction
title: Log interaction
description: Append a generic interaction event to the answers log. Use for lookups, AI discussions, and reading-in-context signals.

lang.description: Language tag of the word: base ISO with an optional region (en, en-us, pt-br). Scoped on the base, so the variant the session instructions ask you to send always matches. Omit it and the user's own primary learning language is used.
